svg.title: Chocolatier — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as chocolatier, wearing an apron and a hair covering. Visible work cue: A six-segment chocolate bar stands apart from a long pointed cacao pod with a single central ridge. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hair covering.
